room_rent.note: If room taken exceeds limit, all other expenses (except medicines) are proportionately reduced

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: 20% co-payment on all claims; can be waived by paying additional 25% premium

sub_limits.display: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40k/eye; Modern treatments: 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at lower of 25% SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year; modern treatments capped at 50% of SI

initial_waiting.note: Except for accidents; not applicable if continuously covered for more than 12 months

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing disability covered under policy has 24-month waiting period; all other PEDs have 36-month wait

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to listed conditions: hernia, cataract, hysterectomy, hydrocele, benign tumors, piles, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

day_care.note: Extensive indicative list of day-care procedures provided in Annexure V

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalization expenses are explicitly excluded under specific exclusions

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to full sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: Hospitalization for donation of body organs by insured is explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance only; original bills required

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered up to 50% of sum insured

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items excluded under Annexure IV

global_cover.note: Any medical treatment taken outside India is explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud and permanent exclusions

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/quarterly/half-yearly; 15 days for monthly premium payment

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; waiting period credit transferred

notable_exclusions: Treatment outside India, organ donor hospitalisation, domiciliary treatment, STDs (except HIV/AIDS), stem cell storage, alternative therapies (acupuncture etc.), maternity
